.bashrc.name: .bashrc
.bashrc.content:
# ~/.bashrc: executed by bash for interactive shells.

# Aliases
alias ll='ls -la'
alias la='ls -A'
alias l='ls -CF'

# Prompt customization
export PS1='\u@\h:\w$ '

# History settings
export HISTSIZE=1000
export HISTFILESIZE=2000

# Welcome message
echo "Welcome to Anton's Portfolio Terminal!"
echo "Type 'help' for available commands."

.profile.name: .profile
.profile.content:
# ~/.profile: executed by the command interpreter for login shells.

# Set PATH
export PATH="$HOME/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"

# Default editor
export EDITOR=vim

# Load .bashrc if it exists
if [ -f ~/.bashrc ]; then
    . ~/.bashrc
fi

.gitconfig.content:
[user]

[alias]

    br = branch
    ci = commit
    lg = log --oneline --graph --all

[color]

README.txt.name: README.txt
README.txt.content:
Welcome to Anton's Portfolio Terminal!

This is an interactive portfolio website styled as a Unix terminal emulator.
Navigate through the file system to explore information about me, my projects,
and my experience.

Quick Start Guide:
------------------
• Type 'help' to see all available commands
• Type 'ls' to list files and directories
• Type 'ls -a' to show hidden files
• Type 'cd <directory>' to navigate
• Type 'cat <file>' to read file contents
• Type 'clear' to clear the terminal

Suggested Commands:
------------------
• cat About/bio.txt       - Learn about me
• ls projects             - View my projects
• cat resume/resume.txt   - Read my resume
• cat misc/contact.txt    - Get in touch
• cat .bashrc             - View bash configuration

Tip: Use TAB for autocompletion and ↑/↓ arrows for command history!

Enjoy exploring! 🚀
